intent: Slim protective case for iPhone 15 Pro (146.6 × 70.6 × 8.25 mm body, Apple 2023). Corrected body corner radius 13 mm. 2 mm side walls, 1.5 mm back panel, 1.2 mm screen lip. Cutouts for 38×37.5 mm camera island, USB-C, speaker, microphone, Action button, two volume buttons, and power button.
assumptions: Apple official: 146.6 H × 70.6 W × 8.25 D mm (apple.com/iphone-15-pro/specs).
Camera island footprint 38×37.5 mm per MFi CAD leak (9to5Mac 2023-04); case cutout 40×39.5 mm for clearance.
Camera island center: 20 mm from phone left edge, 20 mm from phone top edge → case offsets (–10.3, +53.3) mm.
Camera bump +3.78 mm above phone body; fits inside inner cavity — only back panel needs cutout.
Body corner radius 13 mm (superellipse approximation, updated from initial 22 mm).
Fit clearance 0.3 mm per side for firm fit.
USB-C port: 9.5 × 3.5 mm centred at bottom.
Speaker: 14 × 3 mm, offset –17 mm (left); mic: 3.5 × 3 mm, offset +17 mm (right) at bottom.
Action button: pill slot 8.5 × 4.5 mm on left rail at Y+55.5; Vol Up 12 mm Y+37; Vol Dn 12 mm Y+20; Power 22 mm on right rail Y+13.

features.intent: Rounded-rectangle outer shell with 13 mm + 2 mm wall = 15 mm outer corner radius.
Inner cavity matches iPhone 15 Pro body with 0.3 mm clearance; open at display face.
40 × 39.5 mm cutout through 1.5 mm back panel exposes triple-camera island without obstruction.
Bottom-edge cutouts for USB-C port, speaker grill, and microphone slot.
Side-wall slots for Action button, Volume Up/Down (left rail) and Power button (right rail).
STEP and STL files for 3D printing.

checks._comment: Measures inner radius from camera centroid at Z=0.75mm (back panel mid). If the hole exists, walls are ~19.75mm away → diameter ~39.5mm. Solid panel gives >>100mm.
Confirms the back panel ring (outside the camera cutout) has solid material at Z=0.75mm. Region chosen to avoid the camera hole area.
Checks that the bottom wall region at USB-C port height has wall triangles (the slot walls create intersection points here even though the port itself is open).
